title: IAUM 6655 alpaca_paper: target_naked was real (TP leg canceled 14:30:08Z, actor unknown); rearm_refused_flat was a post-fill ordering race; close sl_cross correct
note: MEASURED 2026-11-05 (diag relays; alpaca_paper IAUM trade 6655, iaum_pullback_1d SHORT 137). (1) CLOSE IS CORRECT: venue buy-stop 659384a4 (stop 40.60, trail-locked since 10-30) FILLED 41.14 at 14:31:20Z; journal closed_at 14:32:33Z exit_reason=sl_cross exit_price=41.15 - reason matches the venue (SL), no bug in the reason; exit price is the monitor candle verdict 41.15 vs venue fill 41.14 (0.01/sh x137 = 1.37 USD, pnl column is NULL) - writeback PROPOSED, NOT RUN: set exit_price=41.14 (MEASURED venue fill) on 6655, operator OK needed. (2) ALERT target_naked was a TRUE POSITIVE, not a false positive: venue TP leg b3dee712 (limit 37.35) was CANCELED at 14:30:08Z (order history) while the stop was replaced/resubmitted at 14:30:25Z; sweep 14:31:04Z saw target_naked=1 with a real 137-share position + resting stop (stop_qty 137), then the stop filled 76s after the TP vanished. The 14:30:01Z sweep had target_naked=0 so the TP was there until 14:30:08. (3) ALERT rearm_refused (flat) is a BENIGN ORDERING RACE: the stop filled 14:31:20Z; the journal row stayed open until the 2-read flat-confirm (armed 14:31:50, 2nd read 14:32:00) so the 14:32:04Z sweep graded a row with no venue shares (target_naked=1 again, cooldown-suppressed; rearm_refused_flat=1) and _alpaca_rearm_preflight (order_monitor.py ~10484) correctly REFUSED to re-arm but paged CRITICAL for a position already gone. (4) UNKNOWN (not proven): WHO canceled the TP at 14:30:08Z. No cancel/modify/patch line in ict-trader-live or ict-web-api journals 14:29:00-14:31:00Z (read_state complete, 337 trader lines scanned); no other alpaca_paper symbol lost a leg that window; 14:30Z = US open +8s. Candidates: venue-side action at the open, or an out-of-process caller (system-action/desk) whose log is not in these units. Fed to BRACKETS-ALWAYS (a leg was removed, not moved). NEXT: (a) Tier-1 held for design call: skip the flat refusal page (or WARN-level) when the row is already in flat-confirm pending-finalize, and do not count/page target_naked when coverage source==flat (order_monitor.py ~11014 / ~11100); existing test test_single_row_whose_stop_filled_is_never_rearmed_on_a_flat_position asserts the page so it needs the change. (b) rerun: pull alpaca_order_history for any alpaca_paper symbol whose bracket loses a leg and diff canceled_at vs bot logs to identify the actor; add a venue-orders audit line when the bot cancels a TP. [2026-11-05 ~15:20Z lane ALPACA-TP-CANCEL-AT-OPEN] ROOT CAUSE FOUND (MEASURED, diag alpaca_order_history alpaca_paper symbols=IAUM after=2026-10-01): the TP leg was canceled by ALPACA's own bracket OCO because the STOP TRIGGERED on the opening gap. No outside actor, no app action, and not a DAY order. TP b3dee712-6ee6-4b24-9e95-4d48a33d91ef time_in_force=gtc (TIF hypothesis REFUTED), canceled_at 14:30:08.292Z; stop 659384a4 (buy-stop 40.60, gtc) submitted_at moved to 14:30:25Z (release from held), filled 14:31:20Z @41.14. IAUM prev close 40.50, 14:30Z 1m bar open 41.04 (THIRD-PARTY Yahoo chart API, not our feed) = gap through the 40.60 stop. Same signature on alpaca_live order history 2026-09-28 (SLV: TP cx 13:30:01.911Z / stop submitted 13:30:02.350Z / filled 13:30:03.144Z; IAUM: 13:30:02.116 / 02.485 / 02.867) and TLT 2026-09-22 18:29:09.422/.440/.448. CORRECTION to point (2) above: target_naked at 14:31:04Z was NOT a removed leg; the book was exiting through its stop (Alpaca paper took 72 s to fill it; live takes <1 s). POPULATION (all 4 Alpaca accounts, orders_read, none truncated; sessions 2026-10-22..11-05): 2 TP/SL legs canceled 13:30-14:31Z, both OCO-sibling cancels where the other leg FILLED (GDX 10-30 stop cx 13:31:44Z / TP filled 13:32:28Z; IAUM 11-05). Any time since 10-22: 4 sibling_filled + 2 whole-family cancels (alpaca_paper SPY 11-02 21:05:35Z after hours = our cancel-then-replace re-arm, already filed PI-20261027-KYYBSZXS-0001; new SPY OCO resting both legs now), 0 bare single-leg cancels. REAL MONEY: alpaca_live and alpaca_portfolio FLAT now (0 positions, 0 orders, positions_read 15:05Z); alpaca_live order history since 2026-10-20 = 0 orders (positive control: same read since 2026-06-01 returns 13, the last 2026-09-23). No real-money leg missing; no re-arm was needed. FIX (held Tier-2 PR, alert grading only): sweep grades a missing TP as target_exiting (logged, not paged) for 600 s after a bracket/OCO stop leaves held; past 600 s it pages target_naked as before; protection_state gains additive stop_released_at. DECISION (a) in the same PR: the flat rearm_refused report is INFO while the row is pending a flat-confirm (6655 was armed in the snapshot close-confirm at 14:31:50Z, refusal 14:32:00Z); outside a confirm it stays CRITICAL; the test is updated and a control is added. DECISION (b): see the backfill-own-fill-exits issue #23368. PNL NULL IS NOT A SYSTEMATIC GAP: 5 of 306 closed rows (ids 6414-6913) have NULL pnl, all closed 12:51-15:08Z today, all inside the designed 6 h broker-first deferral (_LOCAL_PNL_BROKER_DEFER_MS; alpaca is in BROKER_PNL_READER_EXCHANGES since 2026-07-30); 0 NULL in the 14-day window below id 6414 (ids 5414-6413 read). No writer fix. Note: 6655's journal entry_price 41.455 vs venue entry fill 41.426861 (parent 2ae76634) is a separate small entry-price drift, not written. [15:40Z] DECISION (b) OUTCOME: no writeback needed. The live fill resolver had already priced 6655 before the action ran. BEFORE (diag journal 15:13Z): exit_price 41.15 (verdict), pnl NULL. AFTER (diag journal 15:39Z): exit_price 41.14, pnl 43.155, pnl_percent 0.7599, exit_price_source exchange_fill, exit_reason sl_cross unchanged. The sanctioned backfill-own-fill-exits dry-run (#23368) confirmed it: SKIP id=6655 exit already MEASURED (exchange_fill), planned 0. 6908 (SLV) was resolved the same way (-534.83, sl). This OBSERVES the designed 6 h broker-first window clearing on its own, so no writer fix is needed. The residual entry-price drift (journal 41.455 vs venue 41.426861, pnl overstated 3.85 USD) is filed as PI-20261105-ETXSFXE6-0001. Draft PR #23360 is superseded by this row (manager may close it). OPEN UNTIL: the held Tier-2 PR (branch claude/alpaca-tp-cancel-at-open) merges and deploys, AND the trader journal shows either a sweep summary carrying target_exiting (the next Alpaca stop that triggers with its TP sibling canceled) or an INFO-level flat refusal with flat_confirm_pending.
